operation_contract.one_shot: Any second call with a non-fresh operation throws before invoking a provider.
operation_contract.complete: Success records the returned owner or resource and marks complete.
operation_contract.failed: A provider exception marks failed and propagates. The frame retains the borrowed cell identities and directly observed boundary state.
operation_contract.destructor: Destroying a running or failed frame terminates.
operation_contract.acknowledgement: acknowledge_diagnostic_cleanup changes only failed to diagnostic_retired after caller-owned cleanup. It frees, unregisters, retries and repairs nothing.
operation_contract.guard: The current 004DE4B0 raw provider performs the real source guard unwind. The adapter adds no guard or fallback.
operation_contract.retention: Manager, owner/registry cells, lookup context and retained failure storage must outlive a running or failed frame.

factory_contract.registry: 00B1B730 resolves the caller's actual F8D41C registry through the same AA0 raw manager domain.
factory_contract.creator: 00B19E90 uses the existing qualified D64470/D644AC/D644E8/D644F0 profile views and current creator selectors.
factory_contract.preserved_absences: No retain, cache append, alternate factory map, fallback resource, null substitution, full B1A4F0/B1B4D0 route or descriptor-sampler admission is added.
